criteria.evidence: Nine named dimensions; three fail. RESPONSIVE -- not measured at all. The only harness that can observe layout (scripts/browser-journeys.mjs at 375/768/1280) has never produced an artifact: frontend/.browser-journeys-results.json does not exist at head and `git log --all -- frontend/.browser-journeys-results.json` is empty, and `grep -rn 'browser:journeys' .github/workflows/` returns nothing (frontend.yml is the only workflow). The jsdom substitute cannot answer it either: test-utils/viewport.ts sets only window.innerWidth and stubs matchMedia, and none of components/ui/page-wrapper.tsx, components/ui/stat-card.tsx, components/ui/search-input.tsx, components/ui/empty-state.tsx or components/shared/no-permission-state.tsx reads either (0 grep hits for innerWidth|matchMedia|useIsMobile|useMediaQuery in all of them), with every CSS import mocked by next/jest -- so the tree rendered at 375px is identical to the one at 1280px. SCREEN READER -- the repo's own contract test records the gap rather than closing it: components/__tests__/design-system-control-names.contract.test.ts:41 sets BASELINE.unnamed = 318, with perControl SelectTrigger 236, Switch 57, Checkbox 24, RadioGroupItem 1 -- 318 PascalCase controls whose ARIA role requires a name and carry none, accepted as a ratchet. Corroborated: 882 <SelectTrigger sites in app/components/features, only 41 with aria-label on the same line. check:icon-labels is green (3878 files) but only judges icon-only lowercase buttons, and aria-semantics.contract.test.ts's own header says PascalCase components are outside it -- so neither green gate covers this. LOADING at route level -- I walked every ancestor directory of every authenticated page: 101 of 556 app/(authenticated)/**/page.tsx have no loading.tsx at any ancestor, and 0 of those 101 are CRM/Inventory. CLAUSES THAT HOLD, verified: error (196 error.tsx boundaries), retry (677 of 699 <ErrorState> sites pass onRetry within 5 lines), offline (hooks/common/use-online-status wired into components/layout/shell-offline-banner.tsx plus data-table.tsx:86 and data-table-skeleton.tsx:33), permission (check:permission-binding exit 0 over 2384 bindings), empty (check:empty-states exit 0 over 3878 files), keyboard.

criteria.evidence: CONTRAST -- three measured holes. (a) components/ui/__tests__/contrast-tokens.test.ts:40 reads only globals.css. themes.css defines 17 selectable accent themes (.theme-amber .. .theme-yellow), reachable by any authenticated user from the avatar menu (components/layout/header/user-avatar-menu-body.tsx:20 imports components/theme/theme-switcher.tsx), and none of them is contrast-checked. I computed WCAG 2.x ratios from the actual hex values in themes.css and globals.css: 6 of the 17 put --primary-foreground #ffffff on --primary below AA 4.5:1 -- green 3.30:1 (#16a34a), orange 3.56:1 (#ea580c), cyan 3.68:1 (#0891b2), teal 3.74:1 (#0d9488), emerald 3.77:1 (#059669), sky 4.10:1 (#0284c7). (b) Alpha-composited text is invisible to that token test: 274 text-muted-foreground/<alpha> sites and 582 alpha-modified text-token sites across app/components/features. One sits inside a state this very ticket owns -- components/shared/no-permission-state.tsx:47 paints the permission slug with 'text-xs text-muted-foreground/60 ... bg-muted', which composites #64748b at 60% over #f1f5f9 to 2.20:1 (I computed it; AA needs 4.5:1 and even the large-text floor is 3:1; the un-alphaed pair is already only 4.34:1, a number the repo's own test records). (c) No runtime contrast measurement is possible in the suite: node_modules/canvas is absent, so axe-core's color-contrast rule cannot run in jsdom, and next/jest mocks every CSS import -- the 22 jest-axe suites are silent on contrast by construction. RESPONSIVE 375/768/1280 -- same blocker as PRD-C009: no artifact has ever existed, browser:journeys is in no CI job, and the jsdom loop renders one identical tree three times. SCREEN READER -- 318 unnamed name-required controls, baselined (design-system-control-names.contract.test.ts:41). CLAUSES THAT HOLD: the loading/empty/error/offline/permission states and focus management, all covered by green gates and passing suites.
criteria.blocker: Contrast is verified for exactly 1 of 18 palettes and for no alpha-composited text; axe cannot measure colour (canvas absent); the 375/768/1280 harness has never run. 6 selectable themes and the permission-denied state's own slug are below AA today.
criteria.clauses_failing: FAILING: 'contrast' (6 of 17 selectable themes below AA on primary button text; NoPermissionState slug at 2.20:1; 17 themes and 582 alpha-modified text sites outside the only contrast test's corpus; axe color-contrast unrunnable without canvas), 'responsive 375/768/1280 behavior' (never measured on a real render), 'screen reader' (318 unnamed name-required controls). HOLDING: loading, empty, error, offline, permission states; keyboard; focus.

criteria.evidence: The only measurement of feedback latency in this repo is frontend/.browser-driver-results.json, and the gate that reads it refuses it at head. /tmp/feg-check_web-vitals-budget.log: 'PROVENANCE -- STALE CAPTURE. It measured build HLbxAqjmWOjuFHatusviu; .next/BUILD_ID on disk is 7Yy5Jkr9TTQ62Z-MCOSvH'; 'CAPTURE REFUSED -- contentAssertion.unusableSamples: 16 sample(s) did not render real page content (branded loader, error boundary, or under 10 words) route(s): /crm/leads ... the capture's own verdict: "capture is NOT usable evidence"'; and 'check-web-vitals-budget: FAIL -- this capture is not usable evidence (1 refusal(s), provenance stale). No budget verdict is reported from it.' Under the exit-code contract that is an inconclusive, never a pass -- and no second artifact exists: frontend/.browser-journeys-results.json has never been created or committed. So the 100 ms claim has no live measurement behind it in either direction. Coverage of the mechanism is also thin: <NavPendingIndicator> appears at 5 call sites against 225 <Link sites and 187 router.push( sites in app/components/features/hooks, and there is no global route-progress bar. Skeleton-on-navigation has a route-level gap: 101 of 556 authenticated page.tsx have no loading.tsx at any ancestor (measured by walking ancestors), so the App Router holds the previous page on screen while the server render resolves -- the 'apparently unresponsive while work runs' case the criterion names. CLAUSE THAT HOLDS: mutation feedback -- LoadingButton disables itself, sets aria-busy, shows a spinner and swaps in loadingText, and is bound to isPending across the mutating surfaces.
criteria.blocker: The 100 ms evidence is a capture the producing driver and the consuming gate both declare unusable (stale build id + 16 samples that rendered no real content); no other timing artifact has ever existed.
criteria.clauses_failing: FAILING: 'Show navigation, skeleton, optimistic or queued feedback within 100 ms of user intent' (no usable measurement -- check:web-vitals-budget refuses its own capture and reports no verdict; the responsive/journey harness has never run) and 'never leave an action apparently unresponsive while work runs' for navigation (5 NavPendingIndicator call sites against 412 navigation intents; 101 in-scope routes with no loading.tsx boundary). HOLDING: mutation feedback via LoadingButton/isPending/aria-busy.
